# IPOCraft

> IPOCraft is an independent Indian IPO research platform: live Grey Market
> Premium (GMP), subscription/bidding data by investor category, allotment
> status, listing-performance history, and structured educational guides for
> Mainboard and SME IPOs. Data is sourced from public exchange filings and
> grey-market indications; IPOCraft is not SEBI-registered and does not
> provide investment advice.

## Live trackers

- [Home](https://www.ipocraft.com/): current open/upcoming IPOs, top GMP, market snapshot
- [IPO GMP Tracker](https://www.ipocraft.com/gmp): live Grey Market Premium for all active issues
- [IPO Directory](https://www.ipocraft.com/ipo): all Mainboard IPOs — open, upcoming, listed
- [SME IPO Hub](https://www.ipocraft.com/sme-ipo): NSE Emerge / BSE SME issues
- [Live Subscriptions](https://www.ipocraft.com/subscriptions): QIB / NII / Retail bidding demand
- [Allotment Status](https://www.ipocraft.com/allotment-status): registrar links + BSE/NSE verification
- [IPO Calendar](https://www.ipocraft.com/ipo-calendar): open/upcoming/closed dates in one view
- [IPO History Archive](https://www.ipocraft.com/ipo-history): past IPOs by year with listing gains
- [Listing Performance Tracker](https://www.ipocraft.com/performance): realized listing-day returns
- [Compare IPOs](https://www.ipocraft.com/compare): side-by-side GMP/subscription/timeline comparison
- [Brokers Directory](https://www.ipocraft.com/brokers): broker charges for IPO account opening

Every guide above, plus the GMP tracker, allotment status, subscriptions,
IPO calendar, and IPO history archive, are also published in Hindi
(`/hi/...`) and Marathi (`/mr/...`) — e.g.
https://www.ipocraft.com/hi/what-is-ipo-gmp and
https://www.ipocraft.com/mr/what-is-ipo-gmp.
